title: Show active CSV rerun log evidence
summary: Pipeline Log surfaces now include the latest active worker stdout line for running CSV reruns, so the floating and detached log views show live import/process/encode/remux progress instead of only stale pipeline_debug.log tails and generic ActiveJobs rows.
reason: The CSV rerun process already wrote detailed stdout progress and the backend exposed it through worker_progress, but Pipeline Log rendering discarded that last_log_line field. Operators could see that rerun was active without seeing what the rerun was currently doing.
behavior_before: During an active CSV rerun, Pipeline Log showed stale pipeline log tail text plus generic active-job evidence, but did not show the current CSV rerun stdout line such as ENCODE progress.
behavior_after: During an active CSV rerun, Pipeline Log shows an Active process log section with the current CSV rerun worker line, including live remux/encode progress such as ENCODE percentages.
manual_validation: Captured and reviewed a local screenshot showing Pipeline Log -> Active process log -> CSV rerun process (active) with ENCODE : 75%; the raw image was later replaced by sanitized text proof under MP-CHANGE-2026-0723-032.
rollback_plan: Revert the Pipeline Log renderer/test changes and refresh the generated summaries for the reverted files. No backend media policy, source, scratch, output, or publish behavior was changed.
